notes.title: Geometry Survivor is now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We are thrilled to announce that Geometry Survivor is now out and ready to play! Over the coming weeks we will be looking to make new maps and content. If you have any suggestions and feedback head to the forums and let us know your thoughts.

Launch Trailer:
[previewyoutube=ogtemkrXtqw;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is also available on Xbox One|X|S, Playstation 4/5 and the Nintendo Switch.

Thank you for being part of our journey!
